name: odoo-mcp-server
description: Give Claude safe local access to your Odoo CRM and projects so it can search records, review context, draft approved updates, and log internal notes. Specific safegaurds which dont allow record deletes or anything which sends an external message

odoo_transport.title: Odoo transport
odoo_transport.description: Choose xmlrpc for Odoo 18 and below, or json2 for Odoo 19 and above.

odoo_api_key.title: Odoo API key
odoo_api_key.description: Paste your Odoo API key here - My Profile > Preferences > Security > Add new API Key.
